descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B28 · P2 · 已知

养老院卡片显示诊断，养老院搜索也按诊断搜（规格要求不显示、不搜）

票：TFA-92581 AC3 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S02, TC-03/S09

思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S07 「搜索字段 × 模式：诊断只在医院匹配，并且只匹配医院的记录」 Search field × context: diagnosis matches in Hospital only, and only for Hospital records

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 2；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3；TFA-92581 AC 6）
  • U5 Nursing Home has no diagnosis: none on the Nursing Home card, and Nursing Home search does not match on diagnosis.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Standard fixture: {hospitalPatient} with diagnosis 'Community-acquired pneumonia'; {snfResident} on Today's Visits with diagnosis 'Post-acute rehab after hip fracture'

When On the Hospital list search 'pneumonia', then 'hip fracture'. Switch to Nursing Home and search 'hip fracture' on Today's Visits, then on All Residents

Then Hospital × own diagnosis lists the patient. Hospital × the resident's diagnosis lists nobody (no cross-context match). Nursing Home × diagnosis lists nobody in either view and says no resident matches

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp1 mustContain {hospitalPatient}; cp2 mustContain 'No patients match' and mustNotContain {snfResident}, {hospitalPatient}; cp3 and cp4 mustContain 'No residents match' (positive anchor that the query ran on the NH list) and mustNotContain {snfResident}, {hospitalPatient} and the word 'diagnosis'. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U23；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92581 ready for qa

在养老院列表里搜诊断（'hip fracture'）还能搜到住户，搜索框提示里也写着「diagnosis」，但养老院的搜索不应该按诊断匹配。

Searching the Nursing Home list for a diagnosis ('hip fracture') still finds the resident, and the search hint offers 'diagnosis', although Nursing Home search must not match diagnoses.

依据：dev U23 (ledger #23). Already in dev report §2 #4, cluster C1 (TFA-92581 AC 3). The Hospital diagnosis search is correct. S17 and S20 in the same unit pass.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
